label: Uranium Enrichment Level
source: IAEA Board of Governors / Carnegie Endowment 2026
contestNote: IAEA has had no access to Iran's four declared enrichment facilities since February 2026. Stockpile of ~440.9 kg at 60% is pre-war figure; actual status unknown. Iran denies 'zero enrichment' as a precondition for peace.

source: IAEA Safeguards Report, Nov 2024 / Carnegie Endowment 2026

label: US-Iran Peace Negotiations
value: No Deal — Iran Offers 7-Day Hormuz Reopening Plan After Trump 'Annihilation' Threat at UN
contestNote: The 60-day ceasefire fell apart July 8 after Iran struck commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz without US-framework clearance; Trump declared the deal 'over' at the NATO summit in Ankara. Iran instead reached a near-final bilateral arrangement with Oman for jointly managing Hormuz shipping traffic that bars US and Israeli vessels. On Aug 24 the US launched 'Operation Economic Outcast,' a 60+ target sanctions campaign, rather than resuming negotiations.
delta: At the UN, Trump said Sep 22 he was weighing whether to 'annihilate' Iran; Pezeshkian responded Sep 23 that Iran would 'never bow.' Araghchi met US envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Qatar-mediated talks and on Sep 25 proposed a 7-day plan to reopen Hormuz in exchange for a regional truce, $12B+ in unfrozen assets and an end to the naval blockade. Rubio said it was not a breakthrough. The US Senate separately rejected 49-50 a resolution to curb Trump's war powers over Iran on Sep 24.
deltaNote: Iranian officials say sanctions relief is 'desperately needed' as the blockade pushes the economy toward collapse, but Tehran maintains maximalist preconditions before engaging Washington directly. Trump has said no deal is likely before the November midterm elections.

label: Supreme Leader Public Status
value: Unconfirmed — No In-Person Appearance Since March; Written Message Marks War's 6-Month Mark
source: Anadolu Agency / The Week / Iran International / Al Jazeera / CBS News (Aug 8-30, 2026)
contestNote: Mojtaba Khamenei has made no confirmed public appearance since being named Supreme Leader in March 2026, following the Feb 28 strike that killed his father and reportedly injured him. Israeli media reported him in 'extremely critical condition' in early August; Iran's Mehr News released an undated 12-second video days later showing him with advisers, which resolved little given the lack of date/location markers. President Pezeshkian has said communication with him is 'very difficult.' Trump has claimed he is '90 percent gone.' On Aug 30, a written message attributed to Khamenei — marking six months since the war began — called on Muslim states to 'identify your real enemy'; it was text only, not video or audio.
delta: Aug 30 written message is the most recent proof-of-activity, but still no confirmed in-person appearance or verified voice/video recording since taking office

label: Annual Inflation Rate
contestNote: Estimates vary by methodology: official 12-month figures earlier in 2026 ran ~54%, while point-to-point/annualized reporting puts the rate near 84-88% through mid-2026. Food inflation alone reached 128% in August. Bread +140%, red meat +135%, oils/fats +219% YoY. IMF's 2026 full-year projection was 68.9% prior to the July-August blockade escalation.
delta: Point-to-point rate eased slightly to 84.4% in August from 87.9% in July, though food inflation accelerated to 128%
deltaNote: IMF's 68.9% full-year projection now looks conservative given rates persistently above 84% amid the Kharg Island export halt and naval blockade.

label: Rial to USD (Free Market, 2026)
delta: Further record low reached late September; USD traded at ~2,335,000 IRR on Sep 26, up from ~2,287,000 on Sep 17
deltaNote: Pre-conflict rate was ~580,000 IRR/USD. Regime officials have acknowledged the blockade's devastating impact on trade; basic goods prices up 400%+ since the conflict began.

label: Executions in 2025 / 2026 YTD
source: Iran Human Rights (Oslo) / Human Rights Watch / NCRI (Sep 25, 2026)
contestNote: Iran's 2025 figure is the highest since 1981. Political executions have surged to levels unseen since the 1980s. HRW and the Abdorrahman Boroumand Center documented at least 59 men executed on political charges between March and August 2026, 29 tied to the December 2025-January 2026 protests. NCRI separately recorded 78 executions across 24 prisons between Aug 23-Sep 22, including 6 women and 9 Baluch citizens. Actual totals are higher as the regime conceals execution data and issues no advance notification to families.
delta: NCRI documented 78 executions Aug 23-Sep 22 (incl. 6 women, 9 Baluch citizens); student Najmeh Amini, 23, was sentenced to death Sep 16 after 8 months' detention in Mashhad following denial of a lawyer of her choosing
deltaNote: Amnesty International's Sep 16 'Architects of Atrocities' report named 87 officials responsible for crimes against humanity in the 2022 crackdown, finding the 2025-2026 repression bears the 'same hallmarks' but on an even larger scale. Judiciary began demolishing Gohardasht Prison (Karaj) Sep 13, part of a wider pattern of destroying evidence at detention and mass-grave sites.
